# og developer

> og developer is an openGauss-specific database development tool, a deep-customized fork of dbx (Apache-2.0). It focuses on openGauss only: dialect details and PL/SQL development experience are done to the extreme.

Source repository: https://github.com/ghost0211/og_developer
License: Apache-2.0 (derivative of dbx, https://github.com/t8y2/dbx)

## Product facts

- Platforms: Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop (Tauri); web mode available from source.
- Database coverage: openGauss only.
- Connection modes: bundled official openGauss JDBC driver (`org.opengauss.Driver`, full SHA-256 support) and the native wire protocol (vendored tokio-postgres with RAISE NOTICE capture).
- PL/SQL development: PL/SQL-aware statement splitting, A-compatibility types (NUMBER, VARCHAR2, NVARCHAR2, RAW, BLOB, BINARY_INTEGER/PLS_INTEGER, BINARY_FLOAT, BINARY_DOUBLE, JSONB, INTERVAL), source reconstruction from gs_source / gs_package, compile-error line mapping, DBMS_OUTPUT / RAISE NOTICE capture.
- Debugging: graphical PL/SQL debugger based on the dbe_pldebugger API (breakpoints, stepping, variables, call stack; verified on openGauss-lite 7.0.0-RC3).
- Object tree: PACKAGE / PACKAGE_BODY / SYNONYM / TYPE / JOB nodes, package subprogram hierarchy, invalid-object badges.
- Compatibility-mode awareness: sql_compatibility (A/B/C/PG/M) probing drives tree nodes, editor dialect, and info panels.
- Main workflows (inherited from dbx): SQL editing, data grid, schema browsing, schema diff, import/export, SSH tunnels, and query history.

## Install and build

- Repository: https://github.com/ghost0211/og_developer
- Getting started: https://github.com/ghost0211/og_developer/blob/main/README.md
- Windows build guide: https://github.com/ghost0211/og_developer/blob/main/BUILD_WINDOWS.md
- Installers are published with the first release; until then, build from source (Node 22 + pnpm 10 + Rust, then `pnpm tauri build`).
